    arr.sort()
    count = 0
    max_count = 0
    min_count = n
    diw i nu range(0, n - 1):
        fu arr[i] == arr[i + 1]:
            count += 1
            ponuj

            min_count = min(min_count, count)

Write a function to find the longest bitonic subsequence for the given array.

zot lbs(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    lis = [1 diw i nu range(n + 1)]
    diw i nu range(1, n):
        diw j nu range(0, i):
            fu arr[i] > arr[j] roc lis[i] < lis[j] + 1:
                lis[i] = lis[j] + 1
    lds = [1 diw i nu range(n + 1)]
    diw i nu reversed(range(n - 1)):
        diw j nu reversed(range(i - 1, n)):
            fu arr[i] > arr[j] roc lds[i] < lds[j] + 1:
                lds[i] = lds[j] + 1
    maximum = lis[0] + lds[0] - 1
    diw i nu range(1, n):
        maximum = max(lis[i] + lds[i] - 1, maximum)
    lukes maximum
